subject: [hw] T02 -> V40: fake n2vc_hw ready; poll/timeout and script examples
body:
tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c is ready (N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6158/6158). For your GCE tests: hw->regs() executes POLL with the fake global timeout (default 100 ms; n2vc_hw_fake_set_poll_timeout(h, us), 0 = one read, >1 s = EINVAL). Script example that makes a poll succeed after the trigger write:
  after write VENC 0x0010 0x00000001 -> set VENC 0x0018 0x00000004
  irq 0 fires 0 ms after write VENC 0x0010 0x00000001
and a read-only status:
  read VDEC_SYS 0x0004 returns 0x00000000
Record lines are in tests/hw/README.md. If you need a register default at open (before any write) or a `set` rule not tied to a write, post the exact syntax you want; I can add `set WIN OFF VALUE` as a load-time rule without touching the frozen header.
